messages:
sam: Quick thought — for the benchmark narrative we should frame it as 'predictable $ per 1k tokens at target latency'. Want two hero charts: 1) latency vs cost per 1k tokens, 2) tail-latency distribution by workload. Thoughts? cc @maya @kevin

maya: +1. Also call out Dedicated vs Hosted delta and the automatic fallback behavior. That helps with enterprise positioning. Can we standardize color usage so cost is always red/orange and latency is blue?

zoe: I can do 2 variants: deck-friendly (clean axes, labels) and compact social card. Need exact numbers to lock the visuals.

kevin: We have the last perf run numbers: small prompts (32 tokens) p50=18ms, p95=120ms, p99=280ms. Cost estimates attached in the spreadsheet. I'll reprofile tonight with prefix caching enabled and a mixed workload.

leo: For the webinar and inbound flow — let's add a CTA on the chart cards linking to the bench playground. We'll add UTM params like ?utm_campaign=bench_launch&utm_source=deck

sam: Messaging options for the hero line:
- Option A: "50% cheaper at same latency for 95% of requests"
- Option B: "SLA-backed throughput with no surprise tail latency"
Which resonates more?

maya: A resonates with high-volume developers (PLG). B is stronger for sales-facing enterprise. We should A/B test hero lines on the landing page.

zoe: Mockups live: https://www.figma.com/proto/benchcards — leaving comments on the color contrast for accessibility (2:1 doesn't pass — will revise).

kevin: Important: include a 'cache hit vs miss' slice. With prefix caching, p95 drops to ~40ms on many flows. I'll add lines labelled `cache_on` and `cache_off` in the chart export. Also include model-variant routing notes.

sam: Short social copy suggestion: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency & half the cost — see our benchmarks." Mini-CTA: "Try the bench playground"

leo: Inbound routing plan: tag leads by model interest (chat/generation/embeddings) and tier (free->self-serve / dedicated interest / enterprise). I'll update the routing doc and map to SDR queues.

maya: Asks for eng/design/marketing:
1) Finalized numbers from eng by EOD tomorrow
2) Three chart PNGs: latency-cost scatter, tail histogram, cache impact overlay
3) Two hero messaging variants and 3 email subject line options

kevin: Acknowledged. Kicking off run: `./bench/run --workloads mixed --campaign campaign_v2`. Will paste the outputs here when the job completes.

benchbot: run started: job 7593. ETA ~2h. Logs: https://ci.redwood/jobs/7593

sam: :thumbsup: Zoe — can you prioritize the deck PNGs at 1200x675 and mobile at 720x480? Also keep an export with transparent background for promo cards.

zoe: On it. ETA tomorrow morning.

maya: Scheduling a 30m creative sync at 10:30 tomorrow to lock final copy and assets. Invite incoming.

sam: Tiny follow-up: include a tokens->dollars legend under the latency-cost chart (e.g., "1k tokens ≈ $0.12 on model-X, $0.06 with batching/caching"). Makes the unit economics obvious.

kevin: Noted — will output a small table with assumptions (seq len, batch size, quantization).

sam: Thanks team — let's aim to have the landing up for the webinar promo next week.
